name: @httpreq/desktop
description: Local-first API client for REST requests.
author: Yamatri Reddy

scripts.build: vite build --config vite.main.config.ts && vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k "npm run dev --workspace=@httpreq/web" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron dist/main/main.js"
